name: Sudoku Capture
summary:
A new Sudoku every day, and if you run out, point your Quest at one.

## 
# *Your room is the board*
Mixed reality first: the board, number pad and library float in your own room with passthrough. Place, tilt, resize and lock every panel; your layout is remembered. Prefer somewhere else? Switch to a sunlit Classic bookshop or the Neon Horizon city, or a haunted Halloween hill where a monster band plays along to the music.

## 
# Made for your hands
Tap a cell with your fingertip, or point and pinch from acr
